synthesis.drift_taxonomy:
Ten ranked drift entry points (likelihood x blast-radius), each mapped to its catching gate + mitigation (doc Part 2; P=patcher, K=kernel):

R1 commit-time index generation [HIGH x WHOLE-SEQUENCE]: replay deriving its h0 column from the live lens buffer reads the NEW lens (committer overwrites :3625-3638 before any publish-site replay) -> wrong h0 row = gate-4-shaped accept collapse; plus zero-accept conflation (paths exclude root, lens can be 0; len=0 TREE event must write column 0 = root state, step t+1 at column t; no-tree-forward step must NOT write). Gate: B (live ordering probe) + A as two-event sequence at all lens incl len=0/max/first-spec-step + C; final F. Mitigation: prev-lens snapshot before :3625, per-step ran-tree-forward flag, bonus token excluded from lens.

R2 remap composition / LINEAR-vs-NODE conventions [HIGH x WHOLE-STATE]: leftover ssm remap re-permutes already-linear rows = corruption; deleting the conv half re-creates the conv-prior-window bug (P:804-821 expects linear column of a remapped conv bank); the two banks intentionally hold DIFFERENT conventions inter-step — unifying drifts. Gate: E (durable diff=0 per column per len) + ladder conv staircase + re-pointed wiring gate. Mitigation: one atomic commit (store off, replay in, ssm-remap-only off, flag mutual-exclusion fail-loud).

R3 CUDA-graph stale captured pointers [MED-HIGH x SILENT-AT-FINAL-GATE]: proven gate-4 root-cause-#2 class — per-step allocs alias per-batch-size graphs; eager dev runs all pass. Gate: durable diff=0 UNDER B=4 FULL capture with varying batch composition + ring step-counter liveness canary. Mitigation: ONE persistent init-time ring (P:184-201 pattern), replay launch outside the captured region (Option 1), no dicts/per-step allocs.

R4 shared @triton.jit body is NOT shared SASS [MED x EVERY-TOKEN, deterministic once gated]: each (kernel,constexpr,num_warps) tuple compiles independently; FMA contraction (K:416) + reduce lowering (K:414,:408-410) are per-instance under wildly different register pressure (128KB h_cache vs one tile); in-repo precedent A1 1.19e-7. Gate: A with the full coverage matrix vs durable bank bytes. Mitigation: identical tiles/op factoring, no autotune, pin cubin/SASS hashes, re-arm per toolchain change.

R5 activation-capture seam [MED x ALL-STATES]: .contiguous() at P:2464-2471 ALIASES live storage — must byte-copy at launch site on the same stream; store k PRE-l2norm, raw_a/raw_b only; bf16->fp32 widen is exact, drift only via dtype changes. Gate: capture-integrity checksum canary + dtype/stride asserts + A transitively. Mitigation: ring [layer][slot][node] mirroring start:end order.

R6 h0 row isolation [LOW x CATASTROPHIC]: writers enumerated — deleted publish (assert gone), prefill non-spec rows (assert disjointness), FR12 splice (hard-raise if oracle on), replay itself (safe only via read-h0-tile-before-store in one program), native mamba_utils ssm copy (UNVERIFIED — live-container read needed). Option 2 widens the window across the scheduler; prefer Option 1. Gate: debug h0 checksum + disjointness assert + A two-event.

R7 +-0.0 per-edge normalization [CERTAIN byte-mismatch if unhandled x LOW value, breaks gate methodology]: tl.where handoff (K:356-360) canonicalizes -0.0 once per edge; root h0 is UN-normalized (K:354). Replay must add +0.0 per edge t>=1 only, never root, never post-store; masked steps bit-transparent. Gate: A's synthetic -0.0 cases. Tolerance here = FR11 relapse.

R8 REQKEY/ring keying at B=4 churn [MED x PER-REQUEST]: the ring is a new slot-keyed stateful artifact with exactly the staleness REQKEY kills; Option 1 keeps slot mapping intra-step stable. Gate: B=4 churn test + REQKEY=0/1 byte A/B; corruption gate backstop. Mitigation: ring invalidation inside the REQKEY rewrite.

R9 bank-write cast dtype [LOW-MED x ALL-STATES if not fp32]: fp32 bank believed not proven (no mamba_ssm_cache_dtype override in repo). Gate: patch-time hard assert ssm_state.dtype==float32 + A compares POST-STORE bank bytes.

R10 vacuous gates (meta) [CERTAIN x METHODOLOGY]: diag[12] zeros-init silent pass in fr10_serving_wiring_gate.py:265-277; fr10_scan_output_replay_gate.py atol=1e-3 exit code; readers of deleted scratch must raise. Gate: this checklist — re-point before the first trusted number.
synthesis.sequencing:
Branch-vs-ladder interaction (doc Part 3.1): the conflict surface is high by construction (verify forward + handoff + both committers in one 7735-line patcher; both sides edit the shared _tree_gdn_kernel body K:282-428 — the very body Gate A certifies; the inherited pop-on-publish hunk from fr13-accept-only-wip @1a566d41 predates cc008587 and is already stale = manual re-port certain; the text-assertion test suites are guaranteed-conflict files). Per-seam rule once flow wc11426x6 localizes: VERIFY-FORWARD seam -> rebase, NO publish rebuild, byte A/B INVALIDATED (re-run A+E+gate-4 regime); COMMITTER-MATH seam -> rebase with manual hunk re-port, no rebuild if the paths+lens interface is stable, A/B survives BUT gate-4 baselines re-pinned (the fix moves the very metrics; if it changes WHAT is published it is silently the handoff scenario); HANDOFF seam -> FULL rebuild of the replay publish contract (row-0 path exists only because of the K:337-340 clamp; the dead-row license must be re-proven against the fixed remap), all gates re-run. CPU tests to co-update on any handoff change: test_fr10_phase4_sampled_committer_wiring.py:119-165/:168-175, test_fr13_nondet_chase_fixes.py:144-299/:301-308, the branch's defers-ssm-publish test; contract-semantic-only survivors: test_fr10_tree_commit_gates.py:182-200/:226-252, test_fr10_tree_conv.py.

Cheapest safe GPU campaign order (Part 3.2) — RULE: run the byte A/B AFTER the ladder fix merges (invalidated in 2 of 3 scenarios, scenario unknowable pre-localization; the gate-4 campaign is doubly pre-fix-invalid since its pass bar is defined by post-fix numbers and 2.024-class contaminated main risks a false verdict + full re-run):
(1) NOW, CPU-only in parallel: build the branch (staging bank, pop-on-publish, row-0 path, ring scaffolding, replay kernel, CPU oracle tests, Gate B assert, flag-ON wiring tests, instrument ports, R2/R6/R9/R10 fail-loud asserts) — rebases cheaply, GPU is the bottleneck.
(2) Ladder fix merges -> rebase (manual committer-tail re-port; full contract re-derivation if handoff seam); co-update text-assertion tests once; verify input-ids-class fixes still in HEAD.
(3) Compile-only ptxas spill gate, both kernels, ~0 boots, before any boot is spent.
(4) ONE binding byte A/B boot (1-2 boots) vs post-fix main — full matrix, two-event, durable bank bytes, SASS hashes pinned; irrecoverable failure -> WY fallback trigger.
(5) Determinism re-probe (1 boot) + CUDA-graph FULL capture gates (shareable same boot).
(6) Live ordering probe then corruption gate (1-3 boots; reuse native+noise arms; probe-shape change => +2 boots native floor).
(7) Final regime: B=4 + FULL capture + SWE-4 vs E5 (within E5 self-noise floor + accept/event >= 3.076).
Optional pre-fix A/B only as explicitly NON-BINDING throwaway if a GPU slot idles. Total incremental cost ~4-6 boots beyond CPU work.
